label: WP Restore helper (delete after use)
info:
Emergency restore for HeishaMoNR settings from a locally downloaded wp-backup-*.json.

Use when Node-RED runs but the [WP Update] tab itself is broken (or you want to restore without it): the ONLY copy of the backup is then the file you downloaded to your own PC with [Back up settings].

Steps: 1) Import this flow and Deploy. 2) From the PC with the download: curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@wp-backup-....json" http://<node-red-host>:1880/wpupdate/restore-helper 3) Check the WP dashboard and the critical settings. 4) DELETE this flow again: it listens on the LAN without authentication.

Default Node-RED settings accept POST bodies up to apiMaxLength (default 5 MB; settings-backups normally fit).
Restore semantics are identical to the tab's own [Restore backup]: every key in the backup overwrites the current value, keys that exist now but not in the backup stay, WPU_ state is never restored.

name: apply local backup download
error as HTTP 500
